brief.title: Generate 1,000 environments, 1,000 methods, 1,000 personas and 1,000 stakeholders
brief.plain_summary: Deterministically generate all four 1,000-item scenario axes (ENV-0001..ENV-1000, METH-0001..METH-1000, PERS-0001..PERS-1000, STKH-0001..STKH-1000) with SHA-256 content digests.
brief.outcome: Verified 4x1,000 scenario catalog covering 25 domains, 5 topologies, 6 compute tiers, 5 harnesses and 10 stakeholder roles.

seed_config.description: Pin of seed and optional slice configuration.

output_store.description: Store for the produced nouns. The default is a placeholder; use the store your owner assigned.

output_contract.delivery: Write produced nouns surface_only under your own authenticated surface, which is the requester's assigned surface, so the requester and that surface's reviewers can read them. Never use public_commons or allowlist other surfaces. Return every produced noun's pin in output.artifacts; add its value when the requester asks for inline delivery.

outcome_meanings.four_axis_catalog_generated: The declared nouns were produced and every deterministic acceptance check passed.
outcome_meanings.no_change: The evidence does not justify producing or changing anything. Say why.
outcome_meanings.unknown: The question could not be answered with the permitted inputs. List what is missing and what would resolve it.
outcome_meanings.blocked: A required input, permission or capability is missing. Ask one precise question.

acceptance_checks.check: Each of the four axes produces 1,000 records with 1,000 distinct SHA-256 digests.

creates.nouns: The worker writes the nouns listed in output_contract.produces and returns their pins.
creates.verbs: The worker proposes follow-up verbs in output.proposed_verbs, such as a breakdown into smaller verbs or a research follow-up, with the pins they need. Proposals are never enqueued by the worker; an authorized requester enqueues the ones worth doing.

required: Run generate_environments_1000, generate_methods_1000, generate_personas_1000 and generate_stakeholders_1000.
Verify all 4,000 SHA-256 digests are unique and every environment names an explicit human_only boundary.
Return follow-up work the results justify as proposed_verbs and nouns worth creating later as proposed_nouns. Never enqueue them yourself; an authorized requester decides which to run.

required_capabilities: write candidate nouns in the requester's scope

execution.inference_allowance: Existing authorized worker allowance only. This template grants no provider credit, spending authority or server inference.

instantiation.rule: Replace each slot with exact NounRef pins, set the params, then recompute the idempotency key with scripts/build_packs.py --instantiate. Enqueue only with your own grants in a queue your owner assigned.

execution_report.purpose: Lets later runs of this template be fingerprinted and compared. It is worker reported, not proof.

summaries.problem: One sentence: what this run was asked to resolve.
summaries.input: One sentence: which pinned inputs were read.
summaries.solution: One sentence: what was produced or why the outcome was no_change, unknown or blocked.

usage.reason: Template only. Replace with measured counters or keep null with a reason.

fill_rules: Copy contract.input_schema and contract.output_schema unchanged, so every run of this template shares one shape fingerprint.
Add context_hash, environment_hash and toolchain_hash as lowercase SHA-256 digests when known; all five contract fields together allow exact matching.
Name the exact harness version, provider and model. Deterministic or human work records the model name as none.
Put what went wrong in an error block and in output.run_notes.went_wrong. The version-1 report has no fields for what went right, next steps or ideas, so those go in output.run_notes.
Leave token counts null with a reason unless the harness or provider measured them.

dimension_basis.reason: Tessera requires these axes, so each is set to its lowest value and the tier is unverified. No quality is claimed. Replace them only with measured values and the evidence that produced them.
